purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Meja Road

queries.query: Meja Road Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map GIS Bhulekh BhuNaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha viewer, UP Bhulekh land-record portal, the Board of Revenue page describing village maps and plot-boundary services, and the state GIS portal. The current BhuNaksha application exposed anonymous level, map-extent, and plot lookup endpoints.

queries.query: मेजा रोड उत्तर प्रदेश सरकारी भू नक्शा भूलेख
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery identified the same official UP Bhulekh/BhuNaksha and Board of Revenue services. The live official selector returned प्रयागराज district, मेजा tehsil, and मेजा खास village labels/codes; no parcel geometry was returned for the selected village.

registryEvidence.custodian: Board of Revenue, Government of Uttar Pradesh, with the state BhuNaksha/land-record service and Prayagraj district revenue hierarchy
registryEvidence.scope: The official state cadastral viewer exposed the Prayagraj district (175), Meja tehsil (00894), and Meja Khas village (163270) administrative path. This evidences a state/local revenue-map custodian, not open citywide parcel completeness.

officialSources.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Uttar Pradesh

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified live viewer HTML retrieved; current JS bundle main-76RVRF3Z.js and BhuNaksha API base https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver observed.
Returned district list including Prayagraj code 175.
Returned Meja Khas village code 163270 with hasData false, and many other Meja-tehsil villages.
Returned attribution for Meja Khas and gisCode 17500894163270, but xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax were all 0.0; no CRS or parcel geometry.
Returned an empty JSON object; no parcel ID, geometry, schema, or CRS.
Control check for neighboring Mejia village also returned zero extent; not treated as citywide absence.

Control check for Unchdih returned a non-zero extent with CRS EPSG:32644, confirming the route can expose map metadata when source data is available; no parcel geometry requested or retained from this control village.

fieldMapping.canonicalId: Not observed in a parcel response
fieldMapping.safeGeometry: Current viewer references map extent, plot lookup, and plot-info routes, but Meja Khas returned no parcel response

parcelDiscovery.compositeKeyProvenance: Administrative selector codes 175/00894/163270 and gisCode 17500894163270 were observed as routing values only; no parcel identity was returned and no synthetic identity was assigned.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh state BhuNaksha service with district, tehsil, and village cadastral selectors.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Prayagraj district, Meja tehsil, and Meja Khas village selection metadata was returned; a neighboring control village returned a non-zero EPSG:32644 extent, while Meja Khas itself returned zero extent and no parcel response.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
uncertainty: The WUP point is in latitude/longitude order and was preserved exactly; it was not shifted and was not used as an absence test.

Meja Khas was identified administratively, but its current public map extent is zero and plot lookup returned empty JSON; this may reflect unavailable or unpopulated map data, not citywide parcel absence.

The viewer exposes plot-info routes in JavaScript, but no safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was available without a valid plot response; no owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested.
No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, or TLS exception was used.
No citywide coverage or adapter qualification was performed; packet completion is not source integration or admission.
doNotInfer: A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, HTTP empty response, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence.
Administrative selector metadata is not a parcel sample.
Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
